close_reason: Implemented as CheckMode { Excluded, Permitted } enum replacing the require_match: bool parameter in check_name_constraints.
description: check_names (line 1385) takes a bool require_match that toggles between 'excluded check' and 'permitted check' semantics. The bool parameter forces the reader to track which value means which. Suggested rewrite: two separate functions check_excluded_names and check_permitted_names, or a two-variant enum ExcludedOrPermitted. The current closure also captures subject, san, and nc_constrained_types from the enclosing scope, making it hard to read in isolation.
title: check_names closure with bool flag is an enum in disguise
